description: Transactions on Machine Learning Research's tmlr.sty (commit 7bf90ef, 2023-06-30), on plain article. Not on CTAN or the engine's mirror: from github.com/JmlrOrg/tmlr-style-file (Apache-2.0). The repository's fancyhdr.sty is an old copy of a mirror package and is not shipped. One column on US letter. preprint shows the authors, as accepted does, with a preprint header. The style loads [T1]{fontenc} and lmodern, so under XeTeX the text is in T1 Latin Modern Type 1 fonts, not TU.
